map.不含税价与含税价互相换算，快速计算增值税额: Convert between tax-inclusive and tax-exclusive amounts and compute the VAT payable from the applicable rate.
map.应纳增值税 = 销项税额 − 进项税额: VAT payable = Output VAT − Input VAT
map.不含税价 → 税额 = 不含税价 × 税率；含税价 = 不含税价 × (1 +: Ex-tax price → tax = ex-tax price × rate; tax-inclusive price = ex-tax price × (1 + rate)
map.含税价 → 不含税价 = 含税价 / (1 + 税率)；税额 = 含税价 - 不: Tax-inclusive price → ex-tax price = tax-inclusive price / (1 + rate); tax = tax-inclusive price − ex-tax price
map.常见税率：货物销售 13%、交通运输/建筑 9%、现代服务 6%、简易征收 3%: Common rates: goods sales 13%, transport/construction 9%, modern services 6%, simplified levy 3%
map.一般纳税人按月核算应纳增值税=当期销项税额−当期进项税额。: General taxpayers compute VAT payable monthly as current output VAT − current input VAT.
map.小规模纳税人按销售额×征收率简易计税，不抵扣进项。: Small-scale taxpayers use simplified taxation of sales × levy rate and do not deduct input VAT.
map.进口环节或视同销售情形下的税额测算。: Tax computation for imports or cases deemed as sales.
map.一般纳税人当月应纳增值税: Monthly VAT Payable for a General Taxpayer
map.某商贸企业当月销项税额 13 万元、进项税额 8 万元、上期留抵 1 万元，应纳: A trading company has output VAT of 13 (10k CNY), input VAT of 8 (10k CNY) and a prior-period credit carryforward of 1 (10k CNY), so VAT payable = 13−8−1 = 4 (10k CNY); if input exceeds output the difference is a credit carryforward to offset in later periods.
map.进项税为什么能抵扣？: Why can input VAT be deducted?
map.增值税是对增值额征税，上游已缴的进项税可在销售时从销项税中扣除，避免对同一个增值: VAT taxes the value added, so input VAT already paid upstream can be deducted from output VAT on sale, avoiding double taxation of the same value-added stage; input VAT used for tax-exempt or non-taxable items is not deductible.
map.一般纳税人与小规模纳税人计税有何不同？: How does taxation differ between general and small-scale taxpayers?
map.一般纳税人实行抵扣制（销项−进项），税率多为 13%/9%/6%；小规模纳税人按: General taxpayers use the deduction method (output − input) with rates mostly 13%/9%/6%; small-scale taxpayers use simplified taxation of sales × 3% (currently reduced to 1%), cannot deduct input VAT but face simpler administration.
